[[Image:Potted_Red_Bell_Peppers.png|thumb|100px|Red Bell Peppers in a Gardening Pot.]]
==About==

With the [[Vegetable Potting]] Skill learned, Red Bell Peppers can be grown by planting other {{i|Red Bell Peppers}}, or a {{i|New World Gourd}} by chance, in a {{i|Gardening Pot}}. When planting Red Bell Peppers there is a chance for it to grow into a {{i|Jalapeno}} instead. Planting Bellpeppers in Gardening Pots lowers [[Insanity]]. Red Bell Peppers can be stored in a {{i|Bellpepper Sack}}.
